api: topologies.training.losses:get_loss('dirichlet-calibration')(logits_or_prediction, targets, *, ignore_index=None, reduction='mean', **params); params requires weight, bias, lambda, and mu
description: Categorical negative log-likelihood after the Dirichlet linear map softmax(W log_softmax(logits) + b), with ODIR off-diagonal and intercept penalties; follows Kull et al., §3 Eq. (7) and the fitting objective after Eq. (8) (paper.txt:276-285, 402-415; src/topologies/implementations/losses/dirichlet_calibration.py:8-86).

examples.title: Fit a Dirichlet calibrator on fixed logits

name: Dirichlet calibration loss

parameters.bias: required floating point trainable tensor with shape [K] and the same dtype and device as logits_or_prediction
parameters.ignore_index: optional integer class index excluded from the NLL and mean denominator (default None)
parameters.lambda: required finite nonnegative scalar multiplying the mean squared off-diagonal weight penalty
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating point classifier logits with shape [B, K], where K is at least 2
parameters.mu: required finite nonnegative scalar multiplying the mean squared bias penalty
parameters.reduction: none returns per-example NLL with ignored rows set to zero; mean or sum reduces valid NLL and adds ODIR penalties once (default mean)
parameters.targets: long class indices or integral-valued floating class indices with shape [B]
parameters.weight: required floating point trainable tensor with shape [K, K] and the same dtype and device as logits_or_prediction
